questions.statement: **Stem:** What was a major cause of World War I?
questions.context: Students in US are studying constitution founding.

options.text: ** Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
** The signing of the Treaty of Versailles
** The Russian Revolution

** The invention of the airplane
  

**Explanation:** The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in 1914 triggered a chain of events leading to WWI.

questions.statement: **Stem:** How did the Industrial Revolution change society in the 19th century?
questions.context: Students in US are studying constitution founding.

options.text: ** Mass urbanization and new social classes
** Return to agricultural lifestyle
** Decrease in global trade

** Elimination of all manual labor
  

**Explanation:** The Industrial Revolution caused mass migration to cities, created new social classes, and transformed economies.
